Checking options one by one;

1) **4A3B5D3E15C6**

After replacing the signs from left to right and using the BODMAS rule,

4 + 3 - 5 ÷ 3 = 15 × 6

⇒ ​4 + 6 = 15 - 6

**After replacing the signs from left to right and using the BODMAS rule,**

**4 + 3 × 5 ÷ 3 = 15 - 6**

**⇒ 4 + 3 × 1.66 = 15 - 6**

**⇒ 4 + 5 = 15 - 6**

⇒ 9 = 9

Hence, the correct answer is **"Docile".**

questions.question:
Each of the seven friends, Kirti, Siya, Amita, Preeti, Deepika, Jeet and Pari, has scored different marks in an exam. Pari has scored more than Kirti but less than Siya. Deepika has scored less than Preeti but more than Amita. Kirti has scored more than Preeti but less than Pari. Siya is not the highest scorer.

Who has scored the highest marks?
questions.solution:
*__**Seven friends:**__* Kirti, Siya, Amita, Preeti, Deepika, Jeet and Pari.

1) Pari has scored more than Kirti but less than Siya.

**Siya > Pari > Kirti**

2) Deepika has scored less than Preeti but more than Amita.

**Preeti > Deepika > Amita**

3) Kirti has scored more than Preeti but less than Pari.

**Pari > Kirti > Preeti **

4) Siya is not the highest scorer.

5) Jeet has scored the highest marks.

**Jeet > _ > _ > _ > _ > _ > _**

Combining all the statement:

Jeet > Siya > Pari > Kirti > Preeti > Deepika > Amita

Hence, the correct answer is **"Jeet".**

If ‘+’ means ‘÷’, ‘-’ means ‘+’, ‘×’ means ‘-’, and ‘÷’ means ‘×’, then what will be the value of the following expression?

[{( 25 × 16 ) - ( 3 ÷ 2 )} + ( 3 - 2 )] ÷ 5
questions.solution:
The logic followed is:

Decoding the information, 

 
 

 
 
Symbol

 ×

Given the equation: [{(25 × 16) - ( 3 ÷ 2 )} + ( 3 - 2 )] ÷ 5

After replacing the signs from left to right and using the BODMAS rule,

= [{(25 - 16) + ( 3 × 2 )} ÷ ( 3 + 2 )] × 5

= 15

Hence, the correct answer is "15".

questions.question: In a certain code language, 'SHELF’ is coded as '110', and 'TABLE' is coded as '120'. How will 'DESK' be coded in that language?
questions.solution:
The positions of the letters according to the English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/889ff2be8a048327f450a975a401b2f4241e5f28d86896613386ad4014cb4505.png] 

__LOGIC__: Sum of Positional Values of Reverse Positional Letters + (Number of letters in the given word)² = Code.

The pattern for this is as follows;

In SHELF →

Reverse Positional Letters and positional Values are:

S ⇔ H = 8

H ⇔ S = 19

E ⇔ V = 22

L ⇔ O = 15

F ⇔ U = 21

SHELF = (8 + 19 + 22 + 15 + 21) + 5² = 85 + 25 = 110

And;

In TABLE →

Reverse Positional Letters and positional Values are:

T ⇔ G = 7

A ⇔ Z = 26

B ⇔ Y = 25

L ⇔ O = 15

E ⇔ V = 22

TABLE = (7 + 26 + 25 + 15 + 22) + 5² = 95 + 25 = 120

Similarly;

In DESK →

Reverse Positional Letters and positional Values are:

D ⇔ W = 23

E ⇔ V = 22

S ⇔ H = 8

K ⇔ P = 16

DESK = (23 + 22 + 8 + 16) + 4² = 69 + 16 = 85

Hence, the correct answer is "85".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

questions.question:
In this question, three statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusion(s) logically follows/follow from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some pens are sharpeners.

Some sharpeners are pencils.

All pencils are erasers.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some erasers are sharpeners.

II. Some pens are erasers.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

questions.solution:
Statements:

Some pens are sharpeners.

Some sharpeners are pencils.

All pencils are erasers.

The Venn diagram as per the given statements:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8a5ba4dee7558f74301d709d4ec78f40931d69a96da24495b577c5ff289f60ad.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some erasers are sharpeners. → **Follow **(Because some sharpeners are pencils and all pencils are erasers so some erasers are sharpeners is definitely true)

II. Some pens are erasers. → **Not follow **(There is no direct relation between pens and erasers so it can be possible but not definitely true)

Hence, the correct answer is** "Only conclusion (I) follow".**

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set.

(NOTE : Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 - Operations on 13 such as adding /subtracting /multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)

(20, 8, 4)

(12, 3, 6)
questions.solution:
__LOGIC__: (First Number - Third Number) ÷ 2 = Second Number

In (20, 8, 4) →

(20 - 4) ÷ 2 = 16 ÷ 2 = 8

And;

In (12, 3, 6) →

(12 - 6) ÷ 2 = 6 ÷ 2 = 3

Similarly;

In (8, 1, 6) →

(8 - 6) ÷ 2 = 2 ÷ 2 = 1

Hence, the correct answer is "(8, 1, 6)".
